Built for zero data loss

The sync layer sits between your outbound agents and your CRM — capturing, enriching, and routing every interaction.

Zero-Context-Loss Handoffs

Every outbound interaction — opens, replies, objections, bookings — flows into your CRM with full conversation history. Nothing falls through the cracks.

CRM-Agnostic Integration

HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Close, or custom stacks — we build the pipes to fit your existing workflow, not the other way around.

Real-Time Lead Routing

Hot leads are routed to the right closer instantly. Assignments follow your rules — round-robin, territory, deal size, or custom logic.

Sequencer Context Preservation

When a prospect moves from outbound sequence to scheduled meeting, every touchpoint and conversation thread travels with them.

Activity Sync & Attribution

All agent activities — emails sent, LinkedIn messages, replies received — log automatically in your CRM for accurate pipeline attribution.

Custom Webhook Endpoints

Trigger downstream automations on any pipeline event. Connect to Slack, Zapier, n8n, or your own internal tooling with structured payloads.
